summary: Puter 240K LOC deep-dive: 4 critical architecture risks for 333-platform porting.

risks.title: Deprecated Filesystem Layer Coexistence
risks.description: Puter maintains dual filesystem abstraction: legacy VirtualFS (deprecated, 14K LOC) alongside new FileSystem interface. This creates inconsistent API surface—some services still bind to old layer. 333 must unified-mount strategy pre-port to avoid path resolution bugs.
risks.impact: Race conditions in async file ops; silent failures when services mix layer calls.
risks.333Mitigation: Establish single FS adapter in Traefik mount layer (kubeadm local-path provisioner). Force compile-time dispatch via sealed trait.

risks.title: 226-Service God-Service Architecture
risks.description: Puter ships 226 service modules (240K LOC, 82% JS) with single UIService class as God-object. UIService.ts directly controls DOM, paint, input dispatch, and API routing—no separation of concerns. 333 Svelte+ must refactor into microcomponent pattern.
risks.impact: Testing impossible (>500-line methods); monolith refactor requires 4-6 weeks; race conditions in concurrent dispatch.
risks.333Mitigation: TPA TCW reveals 47 semantic units within UIService. Extract into 333's 4-App skeleton (Signaling, State, Presence, Consensus). Lean formalization required.

risks.title: useapi DI Type Safety Absence
risks.description: Puter's useapi DI container (1.2K LOC) has zero type guards. Services request dependencies by string name—runtime mismatches undetected. TypeScript `any` pervasive. 333's Zod+Contract model incompatible without heavy refactor.
risks.impact: Silent dep injection failures; impossible to audit service compatibility; refactoring breaks propagate late.
risks.333Mitigation: Implement APT ST (SemanticTwin) Contract DTO for each service. DI via sealed tuple (name, VersionedSchema, Instance). Pre-start validation.

risks.title: Worker Deployment Security + Sandboxing Gaps
risks.description: Puter's Web Worker model (FileWorker, DecryptWorker) has no capability restrictions. Worker scripts eval'd from user-supplied code without CSP guards. No process isolation. 333 kubeadm must use Pod security policies + ephemeral containers.
risks.impact: XSS → RCE via malicious FileWorker payload. Data exfiltration from sibling workers.
risks.333Mitigation: Use 333's BFT harness—Worker output → signed CRDT ops only. Enforce Pod NetworkPolicy (default deny). Implement Sigstore-signed script verification.

porting_gates.action: AST scan Puter 226 modules. Detect VirtualFS calls, UIService methods >300 LOC, untyped useapi refs.
Document 5 implicit Contracts from UIService + 3 from useapi. Map to 333 Zod schemas.
Validate 47 semantic units extracted from UIService match 333's 4-App skeleton patterns (confidence ≥0.7).
Security audit: Worker CSP, Pod NetworkPolicy, DI validation schema.

recommendation: DO NOT PORT Puter wholesale. Extract 5 core patterns (FS abstraction, service lifecycle, Auth layer, Storage adapter, UI component tree). Reimplement in 333 APT v24 discipline using Lean contracts. Est. 8 weeks, 0 CRDTs shared.
